Attachment: dev-sandbox-docker-compose.yml (yml, 1.1KB)

Local sandbox quickstart (copy/paste):
1) Prereqs
   - Docker 24+ and docker-compose plugin installed
   - Node 18+ and Python 3.10+ (venv recommended)
2) Env vars (create a .env in repo root)
   - REDWOOD_API_URL=https://sandbox.redwood.ai
   - REDWOOD_API_KEY=REPLACE_WITH_SANDBOX_KEY
   - PORT_PROXY=8080
   - PY_SAMPLE_PORT=5000
   - TS_SAMPLE_PORT=3000
   - REDWOOD_REGION=us-west-2
3) Start locally (single command)
   - docker compose up --build
   - Services: proxy (env passthrough), python-sample (calls /generate and /embeddings), ts-sample (minimal frontend)
4) Smoke tests (curl)
   - Text generation: curl -X POST \"http://localhost:8080/v1/generate\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"input\":\"Hello\"}'
   - Embeddings: curl -X POST \"http://localhost:8080/v1/embeddings\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"embed-1\",\"input\":\"patient intake\"}'
5) Rate limits (sandbox defaults)
   - 100 requests/minute per API key, 20 concurrent streams; we can raise for short tests if needed.
6) Debugging tips
   - Check logs: docker compose logs -f proxy
   - If CORS on TS sample, ensure TS_SAMPLE_PORT matches frontend URL and proxy includes correct Access-Control-Allow-Origin for localhost.

I'll push the compose + md to the shared Drive link and attach here. Karthik — if you want, I can schedule a 60-minute dev pairing Wed morning and walk Mosaic's engineers through a live run.

-Camila
